attractions.name: Lempuyang Temple (Gateway to Heaven)
attractions.description: One of Bali's oldest and most spiritually significant temples; the Gates of Heaven frame Mount Agung
attractions.entry_fee: Approx. ₹200–₹300 pp plus shuttle fee at base
tips: Start early to minimise queues for the mirror reflection photo
Parking at the shuttle point only (mandatory)
Sunrise or early morning is best for views

attractions.name: Lempuyang Temple (Gates of Heaven)
attractions.description: Sacred temple complex on the slopes of Mount Lempuyang famous for the Gates of Heaven, which frame Mount Agung on clear mornings
attractions.recommended_duration: 2–3 hours including queue time for photographs
attractions.dress_code: Shoulders and knees covered; sarongs usually provided
tips: Start early as photo queues become lengthy later in the day
Carry comfortable walking shoes, sun protection, water bottle and a light jacket for the cooler mountain climate
Keep sunglasses, phones and loose items secure as monkeys may grab them

safety_tips.tip: Monkeys at temples may grab sunglasses, phones and loose items, so keep them secure
